content: I don’t exactly “know” the final size of my response before I generate it, since I compose it word-by-word or token-by-token. However, I do have constraints like a maximum token limit for each response, and I often aim to keep my replies concise or detailed based on the context. So while I can estimate roughly how long or short my answer will be, the precise length only becomes clear as I produce it.
